highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: ServiceNow patches three maximum severity flaws that could put enterprise data at risk and Aurora ransomware actors leverage AI tool for exploitation campaigns. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: SVG attachments used in widespread phishing campaign. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: McKesson discloses breach after ShinyHunters claims patient data theft. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
